# Planview AdaptiveWork - product overview (Avantra summary)

> Demonstration content summarised by Avantra from publicly available Planview positioning. Pending curator verification against the official product page and datasheet. Contains no pricing.

## Overview

Project and work management solution for planning and executing projects with collaborative work management, resource management and workflow automation.

Also known as: AdaptiveWork, Clarizen. Solution areas: Project Portfolio Management, Professional Services / Work Management. Deployment: SaaS.

## Capabilities

- **Project management** - a core capability of Planview AdaptiveWork: Plan and execute projects: schedules, tasks, milestones, dependencies.
- **Collaborative work management** - a core capability of Planview AdaptiveWork: Team collaboration on tasks, documents and plans.
- **Resource management** - a core capability of Planview AdaptiveWork: Plan, allocate and manage people and roles across work.
- **Time tracking** - a core capability of Planview AdaptiveWork: Capture time/actuals against work.
- **Workflow automation** - a core capability of Planview AdaptiveWork: Configurable automated workflows and business rules.
- **Portfolio management** - a supported capability of Planview AdaptiveWork: Prioritise, select and balance investments/projects across the portfolio.
- **Financial management** - a supported capability of Planview AdaptiveWork: Budgets, forecasts, actuals and cost/benefit tracking for work and portfolios. Note: Project-level financials.
- **Project governance** - a supported capability of Planview AdaptiveWork: Lifecycle stage-gates, approvals, compliance and governance controls.
- **Demand management** - a supported capability of Planview AdaptiveWork: Capture, evaluate and route new work requests (intake).
- **Capacity planning** - a supported capability of Planview AdaptiveWork: Compare demand with capacity by role/skill over time.
- **Reporting & analytics** - a supported capability of Planview AdaptiveWork: Dashboards and analytics across portfolios and work.

## Implementation considerations

- Highly configurable - define workflow automation and custom data model governance up front to avoid configuration sprawl.
- Confirm whether enterprise-level strategic and financial portfolio planning needs exceed project-level capabilities.
